naslov: Short clip from a lecture (3/6) — 12 December 2025

segmenti.prevod: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

segmenti.tekst: مَا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْقُرْآنَ لِتَشْقَىٰ ۝ إِلَّا تَذْكِرَةً لِمَنْ يَخْشَىٰ ۝ تَنْزِيلًا مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ الْأَرْضَ وَالسَّمَاوَاتِ الْعُلَى
segmenti.prevod: “We have not sent down the Qur’an to you to cause you distress, but as a reminder for those who fear – a revelation from the One who created the earth and the lofty heavens.” (Ta-Ha 20:2–4)
